remarks: Gated and private behind tall hedges, this modern Palm Springs home sits on a 20,000± sq ft lot in Desert Park Estates with mountain views. The home is built around a resort-style courtyard with a long pool and covered patios on three sides. Outdoor features include a stone fireplace with BBQ, fire pit, infrared sauna, bocce ball court, play structure and glamping tent. A permitted game room with kitchenette and glass roll-up door connects to a guest suite, two bunk rooms, a bathroom and laundry. Inside the main house, a hallway lined with built-in bookshelves leads to a great room with high ceilings, travertine floors, a floor-to-ceiling stone fireplace and French doors to the pool.
